objective: Parse OmniLink responses with the same strict duplicate-key and finite-JSON rules the other integration clients use, failing closed with a bounded diagnostic.
decision_supported: Is the OmniLink response a trusted document? No: it is an external boundary, and a duplicate key or NaN has no unambiguous reading.
acceptance: A response with a duplicate object key is refused.
A response carrying NaN or Infinity is refused.
stop_conditions: The change would need an OmniLink API change.
risks_and_fallbacks: Stricter parsing could reject a real server that emits duplicate keys; that response is ambiguous and refusing it is the point.
